description:
Are you a hands-on engineer who owns systems end-to-end, from front-end UI through service layers to backend data and analytics? 
  
 As a Full Stack Product Engineer at EXL, Payment Services, you'll independently build, deploy, and support secure, scalable web applications that solve critical challenges in the US healthcare payment space. You'll collaborate across development, product, data, and client teams to deliver high-quality software and rock-solid production performance.
  
 *Base Pay Range: $60,100 - $98,700
 For more information on benefits and what we offer please visit us at https://www.exlservice.com/us-careers-and-benefits

 Independently own the full stack, from front-end and service layers to backend, data, and reporting.

 Build and support enterprise-grade web applications using modern stacks: React, .NET Core, Python, APIs, SQL Server / PostgreSQL, and SSRS.

 Develop Python services, data-processing routines, and automation across the application and pipeline layers.

 Use DuckDB for fast, in-process analytical queries over structured and columnar data, powering reporting, validation, and data-quality checks.

 Design and maintain structured and unstructured data pipelines (ETL/ELT and document / OCR / NLP ingestion) feeding production workflows.

 Drive deployment automation, environment readiness, and performance optimization for seamless, zero-disruption releases.

 Own and optimize the CI/CD pipeline across hybrid (Azure, AWS, on-premise) ecosystems, keeping assets secure, testable, and auditable.

 Tune and optimize queries for performance, reliability, and reporting accuracy in high-volume environments.

 Translate business needs into secure, scalable technical architectures, embedding data protection and compliance by design.

 Resolve high-priority production incidents with precision, ensure zero-downtime operations, and proactively prevent recurrence.

 You're not just shipping code. You're building high-impact platforms that touch lives, ensure compliance, and power payer operations. 
 Deliver healthcare solutions that work at scale, with reliability, speed, and security built in.

 Own production performance metrics and implement observability across app layers, APIs, and data-ingestion points.

 Collaborate deeply with product managers, QA, and business analysts to ship features that are user-friendly and technically sound.

 Own multiple product modules and pipelines simultaneously, balancing delivery with quality and continuous improvement.

 Apply strong design patterns, architecture principles, and agile delivery to accelerate time-to-market.

 Proactively remove roadblocks, anticipate risks, and communicate mitigation plans clearly to stakeholders.

 Collaborative Interactions: 

 Internal: Partner with data engineers, DevOps, business analysts, client-service teams, and tech leads. Share knowledge, mentor teammates, and grow technical depth across the team.

 External: Engage with client-side stakeholders and, on occasion, executive teams to understand expectations, demo capabilities, and bridge business needs with technical delivery.

 
 Hands on Technical Experience with: 
 .NET Core 8 / C# / ASP.NET and/or Python (FastAPI / Flask) service development

 React (Hooks, Context, Redux/RTK), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)

 SQL Server / PostgreSQL, stored procedures, query and performance tuning

 HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, component libraries, state management

 REST/GraphQL API consumption, client-side performance and accessibility

 RESTful & GraphQL API design, microservices, API gateways

 Authentication/authorization (OAuth2, JWT), service-to-service messaging, caching

 Python for backend services, data processing, and automation

 DuckDB for fast in-process analytical queries over structured and columnar data

 ORM (Entity Framework / SQLAlchemy / NHibernate), schema design, migrations

 Structured pipelines (ETL/ELT) and unstructured pipelines (document / OCR / NLP ingestion)

 DuckDB + Python (pandas / Polars / Arrow) for analytical workloads and local data crunching

 Databricks / Spark exposure for large-scale processing

 CI/CD with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline

 Version control (Git / Azure DevOps), automated testing, release automation

 Containerization with Docker; cloud deployment on AWS or Azure

 SSRS / SSIS, Power BI, dashboarding and reporting accuracy in high-volume environments

  
 Nice to Have: 
 OCR & claims tech (Esker, 3M, DTKBarcode), AI/ML-enhanced workflows, LLM/NLP integration

 US Healthcare payer / Payment Integrity domain exposure; agile certifications

 US Healthcare Insurance / Payer & Payment Integrity context (preferred)

 Strong ownership, end-to-end accountability, and production-first mindset

  
 Education Requirements: 

 Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent experience.

 US Healthcare certifications a plus.

  
 *The posted base salary range is the hiring base salary range for this role. Final offers are based on several factors, including: the candidate's skills and experience, internal pay equity, work location, market conditions for the role, and the specific scope and responsibilities of the position.

 
 EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a leading data analytics and digital operations and solutions company. We partner with clients using a data and AI-led approach to reinvent business models, drive better business outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, analytics, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform operations for the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect. We are headquartered in New York and have more than 54,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit  www.exlservice.com .


 
 
 


 
 EXL never requires or asks for fees/payments or credit card or bank details during any phase of the recruitment or hiring process and has not authorized any agencies or partners to collect any fee or payment from prospective candidates. EXL will only extend a job offer after a candidate has gone through a formal interview process with members of EXL’s Human Resources team, as well as our hiring managers.
